match.shortDescription: PHP, specifically Windows-based PHP used in CGI mode, contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution. This vulnerability is a patch bypass for CVE-2012-1823.
match.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
